title: Violent Clashes Continue Between AFC/M23 and FARDC-Wazalendo Around Mitimingi and Ngungu in Masisi
detail: Heavy and light weapons fire was reported Tuesday, Sept 22, 2026 through 9:00 AM local time around Mitimingi hill in the Kirambo locality of Masisi's Katoyi sector, North Kivu, as AFC/M23 clashed with FARDC forces backed by Wazalendo militias. Fighting was also signalled on the Ngungu axis and around Miano and villages near Remeka in the Ufamandu I grouping (Bahunde chiefdom). Wazalendo forces had spent the two preceding days attempting to retake full control of Mitimingi. The clashes follow a run of village recaptures the previous week by FARDC-Wazalendo along the Ngungu axis (Miko, Remeka, Kaleta, Kasake) and in Katoyi sector (Mutongo, Katoyi-Centre, Ngululu), underscoring how contested the wider Masisi front line remains. No casualty figures were available and neither FARDC nor AFC/M23 issued an official statement.

title: Kivu Security Tracker: Armed Confrontations Rose 27% in August as AFC/M23 Took 22 More Villages
detail: The Kivu Security Tracker (KST), a project of the Ebuteli research institute, reported Sept 22, 2026 that eastern DRC recorded 118 armed confrontations in August, up 27% from 93 in July, out of 216 total documented security incidents across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. AFC/M23 was the most active armed actor, involved in 85 incidents including 56 direct confrontations that killed 60 civilians, and took 22 new villages, mostly in Masisi and Kalehe territories. In Ituri, ADF carried out 14 attacks that killed 72 people and abducted 64, while regular Congolese forces were linked to 15 civilian deaths. CODECO activity remained minimal and the Djugu-based CRP militia resumed operations during the month.
